name: Scutosaurus Battering-Ram
journal_prompt: A heavy pareiasaur with a bone-hard forehead plate, bred long ago to break palisades. The ones left drag terrace stone in leather harness and push at nothing harder than a stuck sledge.
appearance: A pareiasaur like the shield-beast, heavier in the head, with a broad bone-hard plate across its forehead, and a leather harness for hauling.
